text.label: Shopping list
text.description: See what's on your shopping list.
text.agent: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

text.label: Add to list
text.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
text.agent: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

text.label: Remove
text.description: Take an item off your shopping list.
text.agent: Remove one item from the person's shopping list by its id. Removing an item that is already gone changes nothing.

text.label: Share list
text.description: Share your shopping list with someone in your household.
text.agent: Share the person's shopping list with another person, who can then see and change it.
text.confirm: Share your list with this person? They will be able to see it and change it.

appFunction.why: person-only: only the person starts it, so it has no AppFunction, and a bridge that relays a call to it answers core's typed refusal

text.label: Place order
text.description: Order everything on your list and pay for it.
text.agent: Order the shopping list's items for delivery and pay for them.
